description: This file defines the PermissionMonitoringSupport enum with static methods to manage permission monitoring by registering or unregistering a PermissionMonitor singleton based on boolean flags.

classes.name: PermissionMonitoringSupport
classes.description: An enum providing static functions to control permission monitoring state.

methods.name: setMonitoring
methods.description: Enables or disables monitoring based on input parameters, and registers or unregisters the PermissionMonitor singleton accordingly.

methods.name: stopMonitoring
methods.description: Stops monitoring if it is active by unregistering the PermissionMonitor.
